title: ASMR Scalp Experimentation (Standard)
description: Back when I was working on "ASMR Clench" I made a bunch of snippets, including some where I was trying to get good scalp massage sounds for the main file. Experimenting is fun, and I enjoyed exploring ways to make things more immersive for you all. So... I made my 3dio prettier, and gave it a wig. Though really, it had some crazy bed-head going on when I was done playing with it. Since this clip comes from part of that process, it is a bit more rough and raw then my normal files. Yet I just couldn't resist whispering along with an improvised massage roleplay. I hope you find it brings you a few extra minutes of relaxation to your day. Update Sadly, I had to make the decision to delay releasing new files for the week this came out, as I came down with Covid again. Sorry loves, but you'll have to wait just a little longer, as I sound like an eighty year old chain-smoker right now. And everything smells terribly bad. To everyone who's sent me kind messages of support, I'd like to say thanks! Things should be back on schedule next week, but since I didn't want to leave you without absolutely anything... Here is an old ASMR clip that I never got round to uploading here until now. Enjoy! ♡
author: Mistress Shibby
